description.fr:
Ô Dieu, je t'ai demandé de faire preuve de miséricorde, alors pourquoi m'as-tu ressuscité ?

« Avez-vous une dernière volonté ? »

« Seigneur, aie pitié d'eux. »

J'ai été trahi par ceux en qui j'avais le plus confiance, et ma vie s'est terminée sous la guillotine. Mais ensuite, le monde a été bouleversé par un oracle. Le mal sévit ; c'est pourquoi je vous confie la Ressuscitée. Restez forts et affrontez-le.

Attends, cher Dieu. Je t'ai demandé d'avoir pitié d'eux, je ne t'ai jamais demandé de me ramener à la vie ! Tu ne peux pas simplement les laisser aller en enfer ?

description.en:
Hyun Min is the sole survivor of an accident which took the lives of his parents. Is there a special reason why he was the only one who survived? Is it a curse or a blessing?  
  
One day he discovers a book in his parents belongings. His life will never be the same again… What will the future hold for him? Is there something in his family's past?  
  
One clan is after him and another is out to protect him.

High school is shaping up to be much different than what Young had imagined. First of all, the girls and boys are in separate buildings, which means Young’s got zero chance of casually running into her handsome, dreamy, kind, sexy, gorgeous crush, Bitna. Second, there’s a psycho chick in Young’s class…that no one else knows about! And to make things worse, she is Bitna’s dream girl. Young must find a way to get back at psycho chick and win Bitna’s heart…but luck is not on her side and things quickly spiral out of control.

Now living under the name Seol Eun-Seol, she is working as a road manager for a troublesome actor, because she couldn’t let go of her dreams of acting despite of her deep-seated wounds. While working as the manager, she is approached by Dan Yi-Hyeok, the central figure of the past incident.

“The scandal involving the grandson and the girl who tried to murder him. In short, a cover-up scandal. I want you to play the opposing role.”

However, using these abilities dredges up memories from the past, and the pain becomes overwhelming. Those who cannot bear the pain eventually transform into monsters.

 

A rumor spreads in a school in Seoul about a monster with a head made of flowers living under the bridge behind the school. The school bullies try to force ‘Park Dohyun,’ a quiet student, into the bridge, but his sister intervenes and stops them.

 

However, on that night, due to pressure from the bullies, Dohyun accidentally witnesses his sister entering the bridge in his place. He hurriedly follows her when he realizes she’s inside, but she meets her end at the hands of the monster within…

Lida comes from privilege and excess, the heiress to an unbelievable fortune and a marriage match she cannot wait to consummate. But when the two girls meet and discover the one thing they have in common is their identical faces their lives take an unexpected turn. As Yooi accepts the irresistible offer of becoming Lida's double, she finds herself in over her head, being chased by assassins and falling head over heels for Lida's fiancé. Meanwhile, Lida is completely unaware of the shocking revelation awaiting her.

description.en: Irene, the wife of a minor noble in the Kingdom of Westaria, receives devastating news—both of her parents have died. When she searches for her husband, Cosmos, she discovers that their marriage was a sham, meant only to bring down her family. Unable to bear the betrayal, Irene takes her own life—only to awaken six months before her wedding day. This time, armed with her exceptional medical skills, she vows to take revenge by drawing close to the kingdom’s regent, Base. Meanwhile, Cosmos still engaged to Irene—begins to falter in the face of her sudden coldness. Between these two men, will Irene succeed in carrying out her revenge?

Gang Chan, a young man from a rural village, dreams of becoming a boxing champion. To repay the elders who raised him, he trains relentlessly every single day.

But one day, a group of men in black storm into the village, intent on pushing a shady redevelopment project. Gang Chan stands up to protect the villagers, but the odds are overwhelming.

As he breaks down in tears, blaming himself for failing them, someone appears... someone who will change his fate forever.

‘Agnes’ was a girl who saved the prince’s life by coincidence.
Thanks to his kindness, she received the opportunity to serve as a chambermaid in the palace.
Though initially staying with him as an old friend, An naturally fell in love with him.
However, as time passed and he become emperor, she knew her unrequited love had to come to an end…

“Do you like men much?”
“…You’re going too far.”

An’s face darkened. She stared at the man who’s eyes burned with an intense fire. His expression was grim and unrelenting.

“It’s true, is it not? Jumping from one man to another, you’re insane…”
“What’s wrong with me meeting with potential partners? I’m marriageable age, after all.”

An bit her lip, while Lennox slowly parted his.

“…What’s the problem?”
“What do you mean?”

Hearing her question, Lennox’s eyelashes trembled slightly. His claw-like hands clamped down on her, pressing her against the wall. An let out a cry and closed her eyes. But fortunately, his hand cradled the back of her head, shielding her from the wall. Trembling, she glared at him.

“You said you didn’t like me.”
“I-I don’t know what you’re talking about.”

An blinked in confusion. It was clear he was referring to that particular incident. This man dug into her unwanted memories, her breath hitching as red crept upon her face. Lennox’s face twisted at the sight of her reaction.

“You clearly said you hated me.”
“Your Majesty.”
“Did you really find me that unbearable?”

Lee Hyun’s life that day was no different from any other, until Gu Seunghyeok, the man he had broken up with nine years ago, appeared.

I finally run into an old friend after all this time, and I am offering him a good opportunity.”
It feels like proof of the saying that misfortune always comes all at once.

“If you need money, just say it straight.
Say you have gotten desperate enough to need money earned from beating people up.”
Back then, did you look at me the same way?
With eyes full of disgust?
What kind of face did you have, and what kind of gaze did you look at me with?
The past that refuses to let go tightens its grip around Lee Hyun.
“…It has been a long time, Gu Seunghyeok.”

The Last Question is a science fiction short story written by Isaac Asimov in 1956. The story deals with the development of computers (artificial intelligence) called Multivacs and their relationships with humanity through the courses of seven historic settings, beginning in 2061.

Je dois donc, rapidement trouver une solution et fuir avec le protagoniste masculin avant que ce ne soit la fin!

description.en:
(English)  
In the distant future, Earth is heavily affected by consecutive nuclear wars and humans are barely surviving under a shield protecting their few “Unions.”  
Inside the Unions, people are classified from S to F based on their abilities/aptitudes and live in residential zones that match their classification.  
Our protagonist Jung Min was born as one of the 300,000 artificially inseminated children created to prepare for the future of mankind.  
However, it turned out that he was aptitude-less (i.e. incompetent) and was thus pushed out to the F Zone, the most dangerous and outermost part of the Union.  
Then everything changes on his first day of Adulthood: Jung-min receives an advanced Virtual Reality capsule from his foster father for a game called ‘Beyond.’  
  
(PT-BR)  
Em um futuro distante, a Terra é fortemente afetada por guerras nucleares consecutivas e os humanos apenas sobrevivem sob uma barreira que protege suas poucas “Uniões”. Dentro das Uniões, as pessoas são classificadas de S a F com base em suas habilidades e vivem em zonas residenciais que correspondem à sua classificação.  
Nosso protagonista Jung Min nasceu como uma das 300 mil crianças artificialmente inseminadas criadas para se preparar para o futuro da humanidade. No entanto, descobriu-se que ele não tinha a menor aptidão (ou seja, incompetente) e foi assim empurrado para a Zona F, a parte mais perigosa e mais distante da União.  
Então, tudo mudou no primeiro dia de maioridade: Jung-min recebeu uma cápsula avançada de Realidade Virtual do seu pai adotivo para um jogo chamado “Além”.

This is a story of a boy who dreams of being with a girlfriend on the night of the first snowfall of the year and a girl who he happened to cross paths with on the night of the first snowfall of the year. The girl, however, mistakes him for a pickpocket when he tries to return the wallet that she dropped. Already in a bad mood from a breakup, the girl mysteriously gives him a piece of toast and leaves him standing there in awe. Was it fate or coincidence that those two happened to meet each other on the night of the first snowfall of the year?

Woohyun’s life isn’t great, but it isn’t terrible either. Sure his boss gives him a hard time, but he’s got a stable corporate job that pays the bills. He can’t exactly remember what made him fall for his boyfriend, Seok-il, but hey, he’s handsome. But when Woohyun bumps into his high school love, Minhyuk, he realizes that the magnetic spark is still there, even after a decade. And for the first time in a long time, Woohyun feels totally alive.
